title: Korean-Style Anchovy Fried Rice
description: A savory and spicy fried rice dish made with anchovies and a variety of Korean ingredients. This recipe combines the umami flavors of anchovies with the sweetness of Canadian rice for a unique and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Anchovies
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat 1 tsp of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped anchovies and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the Canadian rice and stir to combine with the anchovies and oil.
Cook for 3-4 minutes, until the rice is heated through and starting to brown.
Add the fried rice seasoning, anchovy paste, and soy sauce, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors are well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter or individual plates.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
Optional: add a fried egg on top for added richness.
